metadata.description: Validation test for GPS Rescue (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T11): fly out about 80 m east at about 14 m, then the rescue switch at 20 s. The rescue climbs to the maximum altitude + 10 m, rotates to home, flies home at about 7.5 m/s, starts its descent 20 m out, lands within 5 m of home and disarms on impact.
